workflow_runs.display_title: wp1356 r1: đột biến r1335 tương đương trên Windows khai theo nền + cặp đột biến riêng cho Windows

head_commit.message:
launcher_test: dot bien r1335 khai theo nen + cap dot bien rieng cho Windows (#1356)

wp1356 r1 g1. Hai dot bien r1335_N3c_phong_lenh_goc va
r1335_F2_path_theo_cwd_launcher la TUONG DUONG tren Windows (lenh_run dat
exe=None truoc _phong; F2 sua nhanh POSIX cua _thuc_thi) nen lane Windows
bao SAI giet 0/1. Gan phan tu thu tu ('posix', ly do) cho hai dot bien ay
va them hai dot bien ('windows', ly do):
- r1335_N3c_win_giu_argv0_goc: bo viec thay argv[0] tren Windows,
  dich r1335_symlink_doi_dich_giua_bam_va_phong.
- r1335_F2_win_path_theo_cwd_launcher: bo neo PATH theo cwd con o nhanh
  Windows cua _thuc_thi, dich r1335_khac_cwd_bam_va_chay_tep_trong_workspace.

Do tren Linux: hai dot bien posix giet 1/1 dung ca dich; hai dot bien
windows in KHONG DO DUOC tren nen nay; t117 1/1. N2 (Windows that) chua do.
